Records.description: Four-loop form factor (Fig. 3(iii)), used to illustrate Type 2.1 (bulk solutions at infinity): the naive sector-by-sector sum UNDERCOUNTS the true Euler characteristic by exactly 1 (chi=13 regulated vs. sum of chi_S=12 unregulated over sectors), because a critical point attributable to the top sector is pushed to infinity as the nu-regulator vanishes. master_integral_count=13 is recorded as the correct/regulated count (chi), not the naive undercounted sum of 12; both numbers are directly quoted in the text. PROPAGATOR LIST, LOOP MOMENTA AND EXTERNAL MOMENTA WERE SUPPLIED DIRECTLY BY THE USER (labelled 'topology 2' in their description), NOT EXTRACTED FROM PAPER TEXT: the arXiv LaTeX source shows this diagram only as a PDF figure (figures/diagram_nplFF.pdf) with a descriptive caption -- no propagator data appears in the paper's own text, though the caption's on-shell/off-shell kinematic statement and the chi=13 vs. sum-chi_S=12 result are directly quoted.
Records.location: Fig. 3(iii) (\cref{fig:app_diags}), Sec. "Subtleties with the Sectors Approach", Type 2.1 discussion
